The provider is Lütz, Luna; Neuwirth, Marius; Fleiter, Tobias. Geographical and temporal coverage: The study concerns North Rhine-Westphalia's industrial emissions and routes to storage; results are scenario-specific. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration.
